HekmaBmi.note: Read by ehr_apis/bmi_rows.py (computed BMI rows are excluded by EHR_SOURCE_PREDICATE)

InternalObservationVital.sql: select distinct 'final' as Status, DATE_FORMAT(dateOfObservation,'%Y-%m-%d') as date_of_observation, DATE_FORMAT(dateOfObservation,'%Y-%m-%d') as sort_date,type as Name,'Y' as internal,'vital-signs' as category_code,M.id internal_ref, M.refValue1, M.refValue2, M.metric, M.tags, M.notes from Vitalsign M WHERE M.is_deleted=0 and M.patientId IN ({patient_ids})

InternalObservation.sql: select distinct M.testName as Name,'final' as Status, DATE_FORMAT(resultDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as date_of_observation, DATE_FORMAT(resultDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as sort_date,'Y' as internal,'laboratory' as category_code,M.id internal_ref, M.notes, M.imageUrl, M.testValue, M.unit, M.referenceRange from LabReports M WHERE M.is_deleted=0 and M.patientId IN ({patient_ids})

InternalCondition.sql: select distinct M.conditionName as `Condition`,lower(M.status) as Status, DATE_FORMAT(startDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as date_of_diagnosis, DATE_FORMAT(startDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as sort_date,'Y' as internal,M.id internal_ref, M.notes, DATE_FORMAT(M.startDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as start_date, DATE_FORMAT(endDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as end_date  from MedicalCondition M WHERE (M.is_deleted IS NULL OR M.is_deleted != 'Y') and M.patientId IN ({patient_ids})

InternalProcedure.sql: select M.procedureName as Name,lower(M.status) as Status, DATE_FORMAT(startDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as date_of_procedure,  DATE_FORMAT(startDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as sort_date,'Y' as internal,M.id internal_ref, M.location, M.reason,  DATE_FORMAT(M.startDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as start_date, DATE_FORMAT(M.endDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as end_date, M.notes  from Procedures  M WHERE (M.is_deleted IS NULL OR M.is_deleted != 'Y') and M.patientId IN ({patient_ids})

InternalImmunization.sql: select distinct M.vaccineName as Name, DATE_FORMAT(vaccinationDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as date_of_immunization, DATE_FORMAT(vaccinationDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as sort_date,'Y' as internal,M.id internal_ref, M.notes from Immunization M WHERE M.is_deleted=0 and  M.patientId IN ({patient_ids})

InternalAllergyIntolerance.sql: select M.substance as name,lower(M.status) as status,severity as criticality, DATE_FORMAT(startDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as onset,  DATE_FORMAT(startDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as sort_date,'Y' as internal,M.id internal_ref, M.allergyType as allergy_type, M.category, DATE_FORMAT(M.startDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as start_date, DATE_FORMAT(M.endDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as end_date, M.notes   from Allergies  M WHERE (M.is_deleted IS NULL OR M.is_deleted != 'Y') and M.patientId IN ({patient_ids})

InternalMedication.sql: select distinct M.medicationName as name,lower(M.status) as status, DATE_FORMAT(startDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as date_of_diagnosis, DATE_FORMAT(startDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as sort_date,'Y' as internal,M.id internal_ref, M.notes,M.dosage, M.frequency, M.customFrequency, M.imageUrl, DATE_FORMAT(M.startDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as start_date, DATE_FORMAT(endDate,'%Y-%m-%d') as end_date,image_id, image_name   from Medication M WHERE (M.is_deleted IS NULL OR M.is_deleted != 'Y') and M.patientId IN ({patient_ids})
